label.summary: These claims concern policies regarding taxation, with a focus on income, wealth, and corporations. Positions vary from lowering taxes to incentivize saving and investment, to raising taxes on corporations and the wealthy, and expanding tax benefits for working families. There is also support for making the tax code fairer for the middle class.
label.title: Taxation of Income, Wealth, and Corporations

claims.claim_text: Commitment to offer tax relief to hard working, middle-class families for the cost squeeze they have faced for years from rising health care, childcare, education, and other expenses.
Support for taxing financial transactions, capital gains, luxury purchases, and domestic and global corporations.
Support for eliminating taxes on interest, dividends, and capital gains altogether for lower and middle-income taxpayers.
Support for replacing high tax rates that discourage thrift with incentives to save.
Support for imposing just and progressive taxes on the rich.
Support for lowering tax rates wherever they penalize thrift or discourage investment.
Commitment to protect and expand tax benefits for working people and families with children.
Commitment to make sure the wealthy pay their fair share in taxes.
Support for raising taxes on for-profit corporations.
Support for making child care and dependent tax credits significantly more generous.
Commitment to cut costs and make the tax code fairer for the middle class.
